data.frustration: Difficulty in finding trustworthy and reliable herbalism resources
data.why: Holistic health enthusiasts are often overwhelmed by the abundance of information, and a trustworthy resource can be a game-changer

data.frustration: Fear of adverse reactions or interactions with herbal remedies
data.why: Holistic health enthusiasts are often concerned about the potential risks of herbal remedies, and accurate information can be hard to find

data.frustration: High cost of herbalism courses and certifications
data.why: Middle-class women are often budget-conscious, and expensive courses can be a barrier to entry

data.frustration: Lack of support and community for women in herbalism
data.why: Women in this niche often feel isolated and lack a supportive community to share knowledge and resources

data.frustration: Lack of credibility and recognition for herbalism as a legitimate health practice
data.why: While herbalism has a long history, it may not be widely recognized or respected in mainstream healthcare, making it difficult for women to feel confident in their choices

data.frustration: Difficulty in navigating herbalism terminology and jargon
data.why: While many women are interested in herbalism, they may not have a background in science or botany, making it difficult to understand complex terms

data.frustration: Limited access to high-quality herbalism products
data.why: While there is a growing market for herbalism products, high-quality options can be difficult to find, especially in local areas

data.frustration: Difficulty in finding herbalism resources that cater to specific needs (e.g. pregnancy, menopause)
data.why: Women in this niche often have specific needs and concerns, and resources that cater to these needs are often in short supply

data.frustration: Limited time and energy to dedicate to learning herbalism
data.why: Middle-class women often have busy lives and may not have the time or energy to dedicate to learning a new skill
